diagnosis.discovery: LOW_OR_UNRESOLVED: no KDP impression or detail-page-view denominator; five new September releases produced at most one processed unit in their first 14 days.
diagnosis.product_fit: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: PMP has 10 KENP pages but no processed units; Odyssey has one print unit. Neither validates a product thesis.
diagnosis.observation_time: The September 4-7 cohort now has completed 14-day launch windows. One window is still too small for price or metadata intervention.
diagnosis.portfolio_change: September 1-21 has 12 processed units and €51.85 estimated royalties. The earlier September 1-14 snapshot had 3 units and €13.77; the later-period increase is portfolio-level, not evidence about the newly launched cohort.

recommendations: Do not change price or description for the September cohort yet; obtain a second equal 14-day observation window first.
Prioritize discovery diagnostics outside KDP reports (Amazon detail-page visibility/search-placement checks) before treating zero units as a conversion failure.
Keep Solar's paperback-only architecture under observation rather than adding a format purely in response to its first zero-unit window.
At the next audit, compare the same five titles at days 15-28 and retain the eBook/print/KENP split.
limitations: KDP reports expose processed orders and KENP but no impressions, page views, clicks, or pre-purchase conversion denominator.
KENP totals are provisional until KDP finalizes the month.
The Bookshelf review sampled the current first page; it did not exhaustively inspect all 30 titles.
